name: Scenario AO: Emergency Callback
comments: Triggered by a Freshchat conversation.created webhook. Keyword filter detects urgency terms (emergency, urgent, burst pipe, no heat, no power, flooding). Immediately emails admin an urgent alert with caller info, generates an AI Freshchat acknowledgement promising a 15-minute callback, creates a HubSpot deal tagged Emergency, and logs a note. Error route sends an internal alert via Resend. All secrets stored as env.VARIABLE_NAME. Timezone: America/New_York.

metadata.notes: Fires on conversation.created. Keyword filter (case-insensitive) passes only conversations containing urgency terms. Register Make webhook URL in Freshchat Admin > Settings > Webhooks > Conversation Created.

HUBSPOT_STAGE_NEW_LEAD.label: HubSpot Deal Stage — New Lead
HUBSPOT_STAGE_NEW_LEAD.notes: Pipeline stage ID for newly created emergency deals.

notes.label: Module 1 — Freshchat Webhook + Emergency Filter
notes.note: Fires on conversation.created. Case-insensitive regex filter: emergency|urgent|burst pipe|no heat|no power|flooding. Only matching conversations proceed.

notes.label: Module 2 — Resend: Urgent Admin Alert
notes.note: Sends a red-header priority email to brian@cwiai.net immediately with caller name, email, phone, message text, and conversation ID.

notes.label: Module 3 — Claude: Generate Acknowledgement
notes.note: Writes a calm 2-3 sentence Freshchat reply acknowledging urgency and promising a 15-minute callback. Fallback in onerror sends a hardcoded message if Claude fails.

notes.label: Modules 5–6 — HubSpot Emergency Deal + Note
notes.note: Creates a HubSpot deal named EMERGENCY-<name>-<timestamp> with priority HIGH, then logs a note summarising all actions. Module 7 assigns and escalates the Freshchat conversation to a human agent.
